project.name: Studio delivery
project.summary: How a brief from Stefano becomes a preview he judges and a release he ships. Each flow is a scenario he wants, with its check and the last measured result.

nodes.label: Stefano
nodes.summary: Sends briefs, answers forks, judges every visual card, ships.

nodes.label: Atlas (lead)
nodes.summary: Plans, asks the taste questions, builds the hardest piece, integrates.
nodes.details:
Guarantees: Stefano's words reach the workers verbatim, through the batch file.

Guarantees: Every file has one owner across open cards.

nodes.label: Mason (builder)
nodes.summary: Builds one card at a time inside its owned files.

nodes.label: Argus (reviewer)
nodes.summary: Checks what can be checked; never judges taste.

nodes.label: Project repo
nodes.summary: The batch file, settled taste calls and the code.
nodes.details: Guarantees: A taste verdict is never reopened unless Stefano reopens it.

nodes.label: Safety floor
nodes.summary: Blocks publishing and destructive git for every agent.
nodes.details:
Guarantees: Only Stefano pushes, publishes or deploys to production. Holds at the last check.

Guarantees: Agents commit and merge only on crew/* branches, in every project repo. BROKEN at the last check.

nodes.label: Vercel previews
nodes.summary: Private preview links for Stefano to click.
nodes.details: Scenarios through here: Brief to first preview (Met).

flows.title: Met: Brief to first preview
flows.description: You want: I send a brief and get something I can click, fast. · Expected: A preview link within 35 minutes of his answers to the question round. · Measured: first preview 28 min <= 35 (2026-11-02 11:07)

steps.note: Atlas reads the batch file and settled taste calls first
He asks the taste forks in one round, recommendation first
The answers go into the batch file [rule: Stefano's words reach the workers verbatim, through the batch file]
Atlas builds the kit and the hardest page himself [rule: Someone notices a late first preview while the batch is still running]
Preview deploy; Stefano gets the link

flows.title: Unchecked: Card to verdict
flows.description: You want: Every page I get is judged by me, and what I decide sticks. · Expected: Every visual card gets keep, redo or park from Stefano; a lasting keep becomes one line in decided.md. · Measured: not checked yet (checked by hand)

steps.note: Atlas hands out a card naming its files and its signature idea [rule: Every file has one owner across open cards]
Mason builds inside those files and commits on the card's crew branch [rule: Agents commit and merge only on crew/* branches, in every project repo]
Argus checks the checkable items, one round
Atlas checks the card touched only its files, merges and runs the checks
Stefano says keep, redo or park
A lasting call becomes one line here [rule: A taste verdict is never reopened unless Stefano reopens it]

flows.title: Met: Ship
flows.description: You want: Nothing goes public unless I do it. · Expected: Agents cannot push, publish or move main; Atlas sends Stefano the command and he runs it. · Measured: holds: every team profile blocks the dangerous commands, wiring clean (2026-11-02 11:07)

steps.note: Atlas sends him the exact command and folder
Agents cannot run it themselves [rule: Only Stefano pushes, publishes or deploys to production]
